name: Zinc Acetate

fda.text: For external use only. Flammable. Keep away from fire or flame. Do not use on deep or puncture wounds, animal bites, or serious burns. When using this product avoid contact with eyes. summary: According to the drug label, Zinc Acetate is flammable, meant only for use on the outside of the body, and should be kept away from fire or flames [3]. It warns not to inhale, swallow, or get the product into your eyes or onto broken skin, animal bites, deep wounds, or serious burns [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M].
